title: SourceEvent
description: Generic envelope any source system sends when a consent-relevant action happens (event registration, new account registration, etc). Kept deliberately minimal so source owners have a low bar to integrate.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract the event was produced against, e.g. '1.0'.

eventId.description: Unique ID for this event instance, assigned by the source. Used for traceability, not dedup.

eventType.description: What kind of thing happened on the source side, e.g. 'event_registration', 'account_registration'.

sourceSystem.description: Name of the system sending the event, e.g. 'cvent', 'vanguard-portal', 'kaltura'.

occurredAt.description: When the underlying action happened on the source side.

consent.description: One or more consent decisions captured as part of this event.

purpose.description: What the consent is for, e.g. 'marketing_email', 'event_communications'.

capturedAt.description: When the user actually made this consent decision (may differ from occurredAt).

captureMethod.description: How the consent was captured, e.g. 'web_form_checkbox', 'registration_form', 'implicit'.

provenance.description: Traceability data for where this event and its consent decisions came from.

sourceEventId.description: The ID of this record in the source system itself, e.g. a Cvent registration ID.

captureChannel.description: How the user interacted when this event was captured, e.g. 'web', 'mobile', 'in_person'. Not to be confused with a comms/preference channel (email, sms) — this is about capture context, not delivery.

policyVersion.description: Version/ID of the privacy notice or terms the user agreed to, if applicable. Lives here rather than per-consent-item since one event's consent decisions are typically captured under a single policy version.

correlationId.description: Shared ID across systems this event also went to (e.g. Cvent, Kaltura, CPMS) for cross-system tracing.
